signal_provenance.why_audit_showed_zero: Dated report candidate_union.universe historically omitted ml/profit/event/news fields (serialization strip). Snapshots often still carry ml_prediction. Audit MISSING on reports ≠ runtime always computed 0. Post-36ffb97 serialize_signal_fields persists statuses on new reports.

execution_chain.verdict: Production does NOT auto-run daily with agent.autostart=false. Observed report days require manual /api/agent/start, CLI, or a prior autostart session.
